name: Eladamri
description: The elf leader who leads the attack on the Stronghold.

description_citations.text: "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri wages guerrilla war against Volrath.
timeline.quote: The guerilla war he wages against Volrath

citation.text: Eladamri (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The elves capture Mirri and Hanna, but Gerrard is proclaimed the Korvecdal, leading to an alliance with Eladamri's rebels.
timeline.quote: leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rathi rebels including Eladamri and Lin Sivvi attempt to sabotage the docked Predator but are foiled.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately, they were foiled

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri's mushroom wine makes Gerrard sick.
timeline.quote: The mushroom wine made Gerrard's head spin

citation.text: Eladamri's Vineyard (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri declares his people ready to attack now.
timeline.quote: We have been patient. We have planned our attack.

citation.text: Eladamri, Lord of Leaves (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri's wife dies in a fire that destroyed their home, likely perpetrated by Stronghold agents.
timeline.quote: His wife died in a fire that destroyed their home.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Lord of Leaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Oracle declares Gerrard the Korvecdal, convincing Eladamri to aid the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: The Oracle's proclamation convinced Eladamri to aid the Weatherlight crew in their rescue mission

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Lord of Leaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri leads a frontal assault on the Stronghold but cannot breach the Portcullis and calls a retreat.
timeline.quote: Eladamri realized that the day was lost and was forced to call a retreat.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Lord of Leaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri learns that his daughter Avila was murdered in her sleep by a Phyrexian agent who stole her body.
timeline.quote: his daughter, Avila, had been murdered in her sleep by a Phyrexian agent while he was away fighting

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri outflanks Crovax's expeditionary force, but a failed rescue lets many survive, including Crovax.
timeline.quote: This meant that more of the Expeditionary Force survived, including Crovax.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Oracle declares Eladamri the true Korvecdal and warns that he must leave Rath.
timeline.quote: who declared him the true Korvecdal, but warned that he would have to leave Rath for another world

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri discovers Belbe looks identical to Avila, her corpse twisted into a Phyrexian pawn, and is captured.
timeline.quote: Belbe looked identical to Avila.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri is tortured by Greven, escapes, and frees Takara.
timeline.quote: He freed the emaciated girl, and together they tried to flee the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Belbe opens a portal; Eladamri poisons her with the same poison that killed Avila and flees to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: It quickly overpowered even Belbe’s robust physiology, killing her in a matter of seconds.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, who had imprisoned Mirri and Hanna, releases them after Gerrard explains.
timeline.quote: He was brought to the home of the elvish lord Eladamri

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven tortures the captured Eladamri but cannot break him.
timeline.quote: However, Greven was unable to break him.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "A chance at freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna defeats a shapeshifter and bonds with Mirri, then both are taken prisoner by the Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: through ingenuity, Hanna managed to defeat the monster.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, proclaimed the Korvecdal, allies the crew with the elven rebels, who help them into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: proclaimed the Korvecdal by the Oracle en -Vec , leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri raids the Stronghold outpost at Chireef and kills all Rathi troops.
timeline.quote: which was raided by Eladamri and all Rathi troops were killed

citation.text: "Rath", section "Locations on Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri rallies his people to charge.
timeline.quote: *This* is our action. Charge!

citation.text: Awakening (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elves and Vec soldiers charge up the mountain despite being outnumbered.
timeline.quote: countless elves and Vec soldiers charged up the mountain.

citation.text: Primal Rage (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri says Volrath shaped the Skyshroud troopers to war.
timeline.quote: Volrath shaped us to it.

citation.text: Skyshroud Troopers (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri kills Belbe and flees to Dominaria, leaving Ertai to submit to Crovax.
timeline.quote: Belbe was killed by Eladamri

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri says Volrath is not the only one who can shape the world.
timeline.quote: Volrath is not the only one who can shape this world to serve him.

citation.text: Elven Palisade (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri decides the elves will attack the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Eladamri decides that the time has come for the elves to attack the Stronghold

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri states his people know their place in the cycle of life.
timeline.quote: We know our place in the cycle of life

citation.text: Canopy Spider (Anthologies, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takara offers to show Eladamri the secrets she has seen.
timeline.quote: There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you.

citation.text: Accumulated Knowledge (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: An assassin kills Eladamri's daughter.
timeline.quote: destroyed what Eladamri loved most: his daughter.

citation.text: Murderous Betrayal (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Captured Eladamri attacks Belbe in rage on seeing his daughter's corpse reanimated; Belbe has him imprisoned and interrogated.
timeline.quote: Eladamri lashed out at her in rage

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Dream Halls Belbe learns her origins and reprograms her portal so Eladamri, Takara en-Dal and Lin Sivvi escape to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: she reprogrammed her return portal to Phyrexia to allow Eladamri to escape to Dominaria

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri throws the last of Avila's poison on Belbe, killing her instantly.
timeline.quote: It was too potent even for Belbe's Phyrexian enhancements and she died instantly.

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rath's rebels united in Eladamri's name to break free of Phyrexia's tyranny.
timeline.quote: Rath's rebels have united in the name of Eladamri , Lord of Leaves, to break free of Phyrexia's tyranny once and for all.

citation.text: "Nemesis", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Abcal-dro has Avila murdered; her body becomes Belbe, a Phyrexian emissary sent to oversee the Evincar succession contest.
timeline.quote: Abcal-dro orchestrates the murder of Avila

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax's assault on Eladamri's Skyshroud elves ends in a rout; he consolidates power by impaling dissenting tribal leaders on flowstone spikes.
timeline.quote: the attack ends in a rout

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai and Belbe fall in love, Belbe sabotages flowstone production, and the Oracle en-Vec names Eladamri Korvecdal.
timeline.quote: Ertai and Belbe develop a romantic bond

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Belbe helps Eladamri and the last survivors escape to Dominaria; Eladamri, seeing his dead daughter's face, kills her with poison.
timeline.quote: Eladamri, seeing only the face of his dead daughter on a Phyrexian creation, kills Belbe with poison

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri makes peace with Warlord Astor as Skyshroud overlays Keld.
timeline.quote: Skyshroud forest overlayed in Keld and Eladamri the Elflord made peace with Warlord Astor of Keld.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri and Astor's armies make a stand against the Phyrexians at the Keldon Necropolis.
timeline.quote: Together, their armies of elves and Keldons made a desperate stand against the advancing Phyrexian forces

citation.text: "Keldon Twilight", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golden Argosy arrives and rescues survivors.
timeline.quote: The ship’s crew pulled many survivors

citation.text: "Keldon Twilight", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri and Sivvi sail on toward the battle at Urborg.
timeline.quote: carrying them toward the final, desperate battle at Urborg

citation.text: "Keldon Twilight", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Llanowar rallies around Eladamri's banner.
timeline.quote: Llanowar rallied around Eladamri's banner and united in his name.

citation.text: Llanowar Vanguard (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri returns to help Gerrard, repaying the saving of his people.
timeline.quote: You helped save my people from a Phyrexian fate.

citation.text: Heroes' Reunion (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tavoc captures Thaddeus in a trap and Urza names Eladamri to replace him, who bests Agnate.
timeline.quote: Only after Eladamri had bested Agnate in combat

citation.text: "Agnate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian airships bombard Llanowar with plague bombs, killing Takara and King Fhedusil; Eladamri guides survivors to the Dreaming Caves.
timeline.quote: causing enormous casualties, including Takara and the king himself

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Seed of Freyalise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves of Llanowar pledge loyalty to Eladamri, declaring him the seed of Freyalise.
timeline.quote: declaring him the seed of Freyalise

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Seed of Freyalise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Coalition forces capture the Koilos caves and destroy the Phyrexian portal with the Nine Titans.
timeline.quote: capturing the caves and destroying the Phyrexian portal

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Seed of Freyalise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise takes Eladamri and his elves to Keld and tasks him to unite his people with the Keldons.
timeline.quote: to unite his people with the native Keldons to aid in the defense of their lands

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Uniter of Keld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Keldon Necropolis the risen chieftains side with the Phyrexians, forcing the Keldons to slay their dead champions.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately, they instead sided with their undead kin, the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Uniter of Keld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tajamin's cudgel triggers an eruption and flood, and the Golden Argosy rescues the remaining warriors and takes them to Urborg.
timeline.quote: The mythical Keldon longboat Golden Argosy emerged from the depths and saved the remaining warriors of Keld

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Uniter of Keld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise transports Eladamri and the Steel Leaf elves to Keld and protects Skyshroud.
timeline.quote: transported Eladamri and the Steel Leaf elves to Keld

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna contracts a Phyrexian plague at the start of the Invasion and dies hours before Orim's cure is ready.
timeline.quote: Soon, Orim devised a cure, but it came hours too late to save her.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Plague bombs drop on Llanowar; Takara dies saving elves and Eladamri soothes refugees in the Dreaming Caves.
timeline.quote: Takara dies saving elves

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thaddeus is captured and vivisected by Tavoc; during Eladamri's duel with Agnate, Hanna dies.
timeline.quote: but during the duel, Hanna passes away.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion all Llanowar rallies around Eladamri and successfully defends the forest from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , all Llanowar rallied around Eladamri 's banner and united in his name, successfully defending the forest from the Phyrexians .

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion Multani senses Eladamri as the perfect leader and travels across the oceans to find him.
timeline.quote: that creature was Eladamri who was currently saving elves in Llanowar

citation.text: "Multani", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Koilos, Thaddeus is dissected by Tsabo, and Eladamri and Agnate destroy the Gate to Phyrexia; Thaddeus and Hanna die.
timeline.quote: together they destroyed the Gate to Phyrexia

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldon Twilight sweeps the Phyrexian armies away in meltwater, an absolute loss for Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: this battle was an absolute loss for the Phyrexians

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coalition storms the Stronghold as Gerrard kills Crovax and Squee kills Ertai.
timeline.quote: even as Gerrard killed Crovax and Squee killed Ertai

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth arrives on Dominaria as a black cloud of death and reanimates the dead; Guff, Bo Levar, Eladamri and Sivvi en-Vec are killed.
timeline.quote: He appeared as a black cloud of death and reanimated every dead thing on the plane

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri's summons brings tribes to lay aside rivalries.
timeline.quote: Tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside at Eladamri's summons.

citation.text: Eladamri's Call (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Freyalise shows Eladamri that his Skyshroud home has followed him to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: "Your Skyshroud home has followed you to Dominaria."

citation.text: Skyshroud Blessing (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In Keld fallen Keldon heroes return fighting for Phyrexia; Tajamin melts the glacier, drowning Phyrexians, and the Golden Argosy saves most Keldons and elves and carries them to Urborg.
timeline.quote: Doyenne Tajamin uses her holy cudgel to melt the entire glacier on which the battle is being fought.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri gives orders to assault the stronghold.
timeline.quote: Now the stronghold will know defeat.

citation.text: Symbiotic Deployment (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Coalition forces fight their way to the Stronghold and battle Crovax's Phyrexian soldiers.
timeline.quote: fight their way to the Stronghold, where they battle Crovax's Phyrexian soldiers

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi and Grizzlegom search for a backdoor into the Stronghold and meet dwarves planning to blast a tunnel.
timeline.quote: try to find a backdoor into the Stronghold

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi and their army commit suicide to avoid Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Eladamri, Lin Sivvi, and their army commit suicide

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard returns with Eladamri and the Oracle, having been saved by Selenia, and plans to rescue the captives and reclaim the Legacy.
timeline.quote: revealing that he had been saved by Selenia before managing to escape.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri and Grizzlegom attack the Stronghold but are held at the Portcullis, then ally with stone dwarves who tunnel in and destroy the gate from behind.
timeline.quote: snuck up behind Portcullis, defeated the outflanked Phyrexians, and destroyed the gate before raiding the Stronghold

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The allies find Gerrard, Squee and Urza's head in the throne room as Yawgmoth emerges as a Black Cloud of Death and they flee on Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth began emerging through the planar portal in the throne room in the form of a Black Cloud of Death

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri and Sivi, surrounded by Yawgmoth's descending death cloud and fires, choose to fall to their deaths.
timeline.quote: decided to defy Yawgmoth one last time by choosing to fall to their deaths rather than let him kill them

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A Hero's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Despite rebel incursions led by Eladamri and Liin Sivi, Volrath's disappearance and Belbe's sabotage attempt, the Stronghold stays in control of Rath until the overlay.
timeline.quote: the Stronghold remained firmly in control of Rath until its overlay with Dominaria.

citation.text: "Stronghold (location)", section "On Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takara offers to show Eladamri secrets.
timeline.quote: Let me show you.

citation.text: Accumulated Knowledge (World Championship Decks 2001, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri expresses a hope to walk where there was water.
timeline.quote: One day we shall walk where once was water.

citation.text: Choke (Eighth Edition, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: When the Rathi Overlay begins, Freyalise plants the Skyshroud Forest in Keld; Astor meets Eladamri and takes him in, uniting Keldons and Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: Astor accepted the elf and began to teach him the ways of Keld

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the battle for the Keldon Necropolis the Keldon Twilight occurs, and the fallen chieftains side with the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately, they instead sided with their undead kin, the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor and Eladamri arrive in Urborg to join the metathran army under Grizzlegom.
timeline.quote: Astor arrived alongside Eladamri in the swamps to unite with the metathran army.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri allies with the stone dwarves, and the combined force attacks from behind, destroys the Portcullis and raids the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: defeated the outflanked Phyrexians and destroyed the gate before raiding the Stronghold

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, Sivi, the Keldons and elves save the Magnigoth Treefolk from the mud-men by burning them into pottery.
timeline.quote: This plan succeeded in saving the Magnigoths from the mud-men.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Astor accepted Eladamri and taught him Keldon ways.
relations.quote: Astor accepted the elf and began to teach him the ways of Keld

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: She stayed at his side throughout.
relations.quote: plus Liin Sivi, who had remained at Eladamri's side throughout

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: She was an elven princess and the daughter of Eladamri

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: She transports and protects his people.
relations.quote: transported Eladamri and the Steel Leaf elves to Keld

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: all Llanowar rallied around Eladamri 's banner and united in his name

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Rath's rebels have united in the name of Eladamri

citation.text: "Nemesis", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
